reply_text:
I answered Dana in a reply to her message in #north-team: the deadline on record for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is 21 December.

That date comes from a single note Marcus posted in #north-team on 14 October, and nobody in the channel has changed it since. I didn't see the team agree on it anywhere, so I told Dana to confirm with Marcus if the tracker needs a firm date. It was fine to share there because a deadline is an operational fact, not a money term, and Dana is in that channel.

The knowledge base came back empty for Thornbury, even though I saved the date there two days ago. So I took the answer from the channel itself.
